title: MCraftEvents
description: A modern auto-events plugin (Volcano, Geyser, Chest) for Paper 1.21+ featuring BossBars, MiniMessage formattin
body:
# 👑 MCraftEvents

**MCraftEvents** is a modern, lightweight and fully customizable plugin for automatic events for Minecraft servers (Paper/Spigot 1.21+). Create unique dynamics on the server through exciting events with animations, boss bars and flexible rewards!

---

## ✨ Features / Features

* **🌋 Volcano:** Explosive event! The volcano spews valuable rewards within a certain radius. Players need to collect them while dodging dangers.
* **💧 Geyser (Geyser):** A stream of water throws treasures into the air. Catch them right in flight!
*   **📦 The Mystical Chest:** The appearance of the chest at the coordinates with a reverse report before opening. Whoever gets in first wins.
*   **🎨 MiniMessage support:** Forget about the outdated '&c` format. The plugin fully supports modern gradient and HEX text formatting in all messages.
*   **📊 Integration with PlaceholderAPI:** Display the status of the current event, the time before the start, or the name of the last winner in the tab, scoreboard, or holograms.
*   **🏷️ Animated BossBar:** Beautiful visualization of the remaining time of the event right on the players' screen.
* **☕ Created in Java 25:** Optimal performance on the latest kernel versions.

---

# Commands and Rights / Commands & Permissions

* `/mct start <event_id>` — Start the event manually (`mcraftevents.admin`)
* `/mct stop` — Stop the currently active event (`mcraftevents.admin`)
* `/mct reload' — To reload the plugin configuration (`mcraftevents.admin`)

---

## ⚙️ Dependencies / Dependencies

* **Paper / Purpur 1.21+** (Recommended)
* **Placeholder API** (Optional, for placeholder operation)
